meta.name: gtars
meta.description: High-performance toolkit for genomic interval analysis in Rust with Python bindings. Use when working with genomic regions, BED files, coverage tracks, overlap detection, tokenization for ML models, or fragment analysis in computational genomics and machine learning applications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间与BED文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理基因组区域、覆盖度或片段分析。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic intervals and BED files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic regions, coverage, or fragment analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以处理基因组区间数据，包括检测重叠区域、生成覆盖度轨迹、将基因组区域转换为机器学习用的令牌，以及管理参考序列。
howto.when: 当你提到基因组区间文件（如 BED 格式）、重叠检测、覆盖度轨迹、基因组机器学习预处理或单细胞片段分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出这两个 BED 文件中的重叠区域。
用这个片段文件生成 BigWig 覆盖度轨迹。
将训练区域文件中的区间转换为令牌。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process genomic interval data, including detecting overlaps, generating coverage tracks, tokenizing genomic regions for ML, and managing reference sequences.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention genomic interval files (e.g., BED format), overlap detection, coverage tracks, genomic ML preprocessing, or single-cell fragment analysis.

say_en.text: Find overlapping regions between these two BED files.
Generate a BigWig coverage track from this fragment file.
Tokenize intervals from the training regions file.
